text: Congratulations to Balakrishnan Dharmalingam for successfully received his PhD degree from my team!
I received support from the "Summer Institute on AI Integration in Cybersecurity Education (Summer 2026)," Washington, D.C. Thanks to George Washington University and the NSF.

Our paper "When Memory Hurts: Amplifying Mission-Channel Attacks in LLM-Driven UAV Agents" has been accepted at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026). Congratulations to the team!

I received a National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource (NAIRR) award of GPU credits to investigate an autonomous, LLM-orchestrated pipeline for molecular design and chemical sensing. The project runs 2026–2027.

Our paper "AeroMind: Poisoning the Shared-Memory Control Plane of an LLM-Driven Multi-UAV System" has been directly accepted at the 22nd ACM ASIA Conference on Computer and Communications Security (AsiaCCS 2027, Cycle 1), with a direct acceptance rate of 7.6% (39 of 514 submissions). Congratulations to Ibrahim Odat and the team!
